name: Firmware Size Diff
blurb: symbol-by-symbol size change between two builds, largest first
intro: Paste the symbol sizes of two builds (nm -S output, a GNU ld map file, size -A, bloaty CSV or name/size lines) and see what grew, shrank, appeared or vanished, largest change first, with the flash and RAM totals split by text, rodata, data and bss.

usage: Give before and after as text: the output of nm -S (--print-size, hex sizes), a GNU ld .map file, size -A, bloaty --csv, or 'name size' lines in decimal; top = how many symbols to list and minDelta = smallest change in bytes to show. Returns the total, flash and RAM change in bytes, counts of added/removed/grown/shrunk symbols, a table of changed symbols sorted by absolute change, a by-region table and a Markdown summary. Use it in code review or CI to explain a firmware size jump.
sources: GNU Binutils documentation: nm (--print-size, symbol type letters) and size (-A / Berkeley formats)
GNU ld manual: map file (-Map) layout
